fullPassage: Anger is clearly related to aggression but they are not one and the same. It is possible to be aggressive without being angry, and it is equally possible to be angry without becoming aggressive. However, the two (the emotion of anger and the behaviour of aggression) are linked and are biologically based, with obvious survival value. Anger always results in a much increased burst of energy and, although biologically based, is seen by some psychologists as largely socially constructed. That is, some people might be temperamentally more prone to anger than others, but the extent to which they express this is probably socially determined. In our culture, for example, boys are encouraged to express their anger more openly than girls and a far greater proportion of men than women are made to take anger management courses. These are learned differences, not differences of biology.

det.tip: biologically based=생물학적으로 기반을 둔. 부사가 분사를 수식

questions.passage: In our culture, for example, boys are encouraged to express their anger more openly than girls and a far greater proportion of men than women are __________ (make) to take anger management courses.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: make → made: 'be made to+동사원형' 수동 사역 구문의 과거분사
det.analysis: make(동사) → made(과거분사). 'are made to take'는 사역동사 make의 수동태. 주어(men)가 강요를 '당하는' 것이므로 be동사(are) + 과거분사(made) 필요
det.tip: be made to+V=~하도록 강요되다. 사역동사 make의 수동태는 to부정사 유지

questions.passage: Anger is clearly related to aggression but they are not one and the same. It is possible to be aggressive without being angry, and it is equally possible to be angry without becoming aggressive. However, the two (the emotion of anger and the behaviour of aggression) are linked and are biologically based, with obvious survival value. Anger always results in a much increased burst of energy and, although biologically based, is seen by some psychologists as largely __________. That is, some people might be temperamentally more prone to anger than others, but the extent to which they express this is probably socially determined. In our culture, for example, boys are encouraged to express their anger more openly than girls and a far greater proportion of men than women are made to take anger management courses. These are learned differences, not differences of biology.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 분노는 생물학적 기반이지만 대체로 ______된 것으로 여겨진다
det.analysis:
❌ ① biologically fixed(생물학적으로 고정된): 바로 앞 'biologically based'와 대비되는 말이 필요
❌ ② medically treated(의학적으로 치료된): 문맥 무관
❌ ③ legally required(법적으로 요구된): 문맥 무관
✅ ④ socially constructed(사회적으로 구성된): 생물학적 기반이나 '사회적으로 구성'된 것으로 봄 ← 정답
det.tip: although biologically based ~ socially constructed. 생물학 대 사회의 대비

det.korean: 이것들은 생물학의 차이가 아니라 ______이다
det.analysis:
❌ ① biological instincts(생물학적 본능): 바로 뒤 'not differences of biology'와 모순
❌ ② universal reactions(보편적 반응): 문화별 차이 맥락과 반대
✅ ③ learned differences(학습된 차이): 생물학이 아닌 '학습된 차이' ← 정답
❌ ④ physical traits(신체적 특성): 생물학 범주라 모순
det.tip: learned differences, not differences of biology. 학습 대 생물학의 대비
